Follow-up from #34990 (PR #35423), seat 5's pick A. #35423 retired the client two-step for relationship-path drills, so the "too many related records" path can no longer be reached. #35423 kept these pieces and marked them `@deprecated`, because removing them narrows a published export:

- `DATASET_DRILL_RELATED_ID_CAP` and the `too-many` member of `DatasetDrillResolution` (`@object-ui/core`, `ui/packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts`);
- the too-many arms in `DatasetWidget.tsx` (plugin-dashboard) and `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` (plugin-report);
- the `too-many` entry in `DrillDownDrawer`'s notice table and its strings in 11 locale packs.

Also stale: a comment in `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/queryDataset.test.ts` ("resolved through the related ids first").

## This is a narrowing
Removing an exported constant and a union member narrows `@object-ui/core`'s published surface. The PR takes the narrowing arm: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, the ADR-0087 marker, and the matching changeset level. #35423 itself stays `Clause-②: no`.

## Done when
The listed pieces are removed, no consumer references them, the locale packs drop the strings in step (key-parity tests green), and the export removal carries the ADR-0087 marker.
